title: Table A.2: Meson, baryon, and Eightfold multiplet spectrum ($\mathcal{L}_1\text{--}\mathcal{L}_2$, 80-digit Fréchet--Jacobian atlas)
html:
Archimedean specialisation. Hadron and Eightfold multiplet observables at q_0^{(p)} (80-digit precision) with exact (m_e, \mathfrak{D}_\beta, m_{\pi^\pm}) Fréchet--Jacobian uncertainties \sigma_{\mathrm{pred}}. Notice that m_{K^\pm}/m_{\pi^\pm} is dimensionless (\partial/\partial m_{\pi^\pm} = 0, \sigma_{\mathrm{pred}} \sim 10^{-11}), whereas rendering m_{K^\pm} in \mathrm{MeV} inherits the 1.29\;\mathrm{ppm} uncertainty of m_{\pi^\pm}.

1. Species / Observable & Layer 2. Canonical Braid / Motif Normal Form 3. Symbolic Formula & Epistemic Tier 4. Predicted O_{\mathrm{pred}} \pm \sigma_{\mathrm{pred}} ([\Delta_{\mu\text{-pin}}]) 5. Experimental O_{\mathrm{exp}} \pm \sigma_{\mathrm{exp}} (Source) 6. Residual \Delta, Rel. Miss, Pulls (\Delta/\sigma_{\mathrm{exp}},\; z_{\mathrm{comb}})
